articles.author: Finn McHugh, Paul Karp
articles.title: Independent MP Helen Haines critically injured in attack near electorate office - Politico
articles.description: A suspect is in custody after the Australian MP was struck by a vehicle near her electorate office on Monday afternoon.
articles.content:
CANBERRA Independent MP Helen Haines has been seriously injured in an attack near her electorate office, with a suspect in custody and Australias counter-terror team activated.
